title: Lisse local freeness from normalized slice localization
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $X$ on which $\ell$ is invertible in every residue field. Let $d_X$ and $d_U$ for every pro-etale object $U$ be specified LocalizationData [def-tw-lisse-localization-data]. Assume their normalized SliceCoefficients, SliceLocalization and SliceLimitCompatibility exist on every chart, and sheaf tensor restriction is compatible for both $B_X$ and $A_X$. Then for every rational lisse heart object $K$ [def-real-rational-lisse-heart], $H^0(J_XK)$ is finite locally free over $A_X$ [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. Moreover the recorded rational coefficient unit [def-a1-common-stage-coefficient-unit] realizes $A_X[0]$. Ranks may vary and may be zero. This assertion neither constructs any localization or slice model nor asserts the derived Hom comparison or degree-zero concentration.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2, Definitions 6.8.3 and 6.8.8; source restriction and exact scalar localization in Proposition 6.8.14(2)

proof.text: Completed chart pullback is a derived limit of finite pullbacks of the reductions. The pro-etale object inverse-image comparison makes those finite pullbacks ordinary restrictions; derived tensor pullback identifies the resulting reduction towers. Derived completeness, strict-limit compatibility and uniqueness of derived limits identify completed pullback with restriction.

Apply the supplied rational realization and scalar-extension slice comparison to each defining local rational isomorphism. Scalar extension of a free rank r module is free rank r by the mutually inverse multiplication and finite-basis-sum maps. Exact restriction commutes with H^0, so these maps trivialize H^0 of the realization on the same covering.

For the recorded completed unit, derived completeness identifies its normalized system of ring reductions with B in degree zero. Exact scalar extension and the rank-one multiplication map give A in degree zero. Empty bases and varying chart ranks are allowed throughout.

lean.statement: theorem localization_localFreeness (X : Scheme.{u}) [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] (dx : LocalizationData l E X) (du : ∀ U : X.ProEt, LocalizationData l E U.left) (hs : ∀ U : X.ProEt, ∃ c : SliceCoefficients l E U, Nonempty (SliceLocalization l E dx U (du U) c) ∧ SliceLimitCompatibility U (X.adicLisseForget.obj (integralRing l E X)) ∧ SliceTensorCompatibility (integralRing l E X) U ∧ SliceTensorCompatibility (rationalRing l E X) U) : (∀ K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X, rationalLisseHeartProperty l E X K → SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules X (rationalRing l E X)) 0).obj (dx.realization.obj K))) ∧ Nonempty (dx.realization.obj (pullbackTensorRationalUnit l E X) ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules X (rationalRing l E X)) 0).obj (SheafOfModules.unit (X.adicLisseForget.obj (rationalRing l E X))))
